title: Post-start cancellation becomes a reviewable case; the operational booking state is preserved
approved_by: PawSpace business decision supplied 2026-08-26, confirmed as final
state_flow: Cancellation requested -> Case opened -> Booking remains active -> Operations decision -> Finance decision if applicable -> Customer and provider notified -> Case closed

per_status.on_the_way / en_route: booking stays active; Operations decides proceed, stop or return
per_status.arrived: booking stays active; Operations decides proceed, stop or return
per_status.in_service: booking stays in service; the customer cannot cancel it automatically; Operations may proceed or stop
per_status.completed: cancellation is unavailable; the request becomes a service-quality/refund dispute

guarantees_implemented: Opening a case promises no refund and reverses nothing.
Payment, provider payout, attendance, OTP, delivery evidence and service records are unchanged until an authorised decision.
Only Operations/Manager staff may operationally stop a job, checked against the actor's real permission set from policy rather than assumed of the caller.
Only Finance/Manager roles may approve a full or partial refund - a separate decision, separately authorised, never implied by the Operations decision.
A stop writes the distinct terminal status `stopped_after_start`, never ordinary `cancelled`; the configuration surface refuses to save `cancelled` as that status.
Every decision records actor, reason, timestamp, evidence where the policy requires it, and the customer/provider communication.
Provider payout stays a calculation from arrival, work performed, travel and fault attribution - an open case does not touch the payout line.
Exactly one open case per booking, enforced by a partial UNIQUE index rather than by handler logic, so concurrency cannot open a second. A repeat request reuses it and is recorded as a repeat.
configurable: Everything above is the `cancellation_case_policy` domain in service_policy_configs - reason categories, which statuses open a case, which Operations decisions each status offers, the terminal status name, and both permission sets - scoped by service and city and edited in Control Center under Business policy.

defect_found_while_building.what: The approved rule names EN_ROUTE; this platform's lifecycle calls the same state `on_the_way`. With only `en_route` configured, a booking marked on_the_way fell past the status check into the notice ladder.
defect_found_while_building.measured: status on_the_way with 48 hours of remaining notice -> HTTP 200 and an automatic Rs 2,000 refund, with the provider already driving.
defect_found_while_building.honest_scope: Near the start time the ladder answers 0% anyway and a case opens either way, so the reachable window is a provider marked on_the_way well before the appointment - which app/api/grooming-lifecycle does not guard against. Recorded rather than overstated.
defect_found_while_building.correction_to_my_own_test: The first version of the regression seeded a start time in the past, so it passed whether or not on_the_way was configured. Sabotage verification caught that it proved nothing; the case now uses a far-future start so the STATUS is the only thing that can refuse, and dropping on_the_way fails it.

files.gateway: lib/api-gateway.ts maps /api/booking-cancellation-case to bookings.view as the floor; who may stop or refund is policy applied against the actor's permissions
tables: booking_cancellation_cases (partial UNIQUE index on one open case per booking)

sabotage_verification: The customer request cancels the booking again (the original defect) -> 10 of 14 fail.
A stop writes ordinary 'cancelled' -> only CASE-6 fails.
The one-open-case rule dropped -> only CASE-3/4 fails.
on_the_way dropped from the blocked statuses -> only the status case fails (after that case was corrected to be load-bearing).
non_vacuity_controls: a booking that has NOT started still cancels directly and opens no case - routing every cancellation to a case would satisfy every other assertion and replace self-serve cancellation with a manual queue
a provider driving at short notice also opens a case - the everyday shape of the same state, kept beside the artificial one
Operations decisions are bounded by the status the request was made at, and the refusal names what is available
